symptom: OCR fallback silently fails or throws ImportError / TypeError on modern surya-ocr installs. Scanned PDF pages return empty text.
rootcause: extractor.py:69 calls run_ocr([page_image], [_surya_model], lang=['en']) and uses ModelLst() — both the function signature and model loader changed in surya-ocr >= 0.6. The current call pattern matches an older API.
fix: Check installed surya-ocr version. For >= 0.6, replace ModelLst() with the new model loading API and update the run_ocr() call signature to match. Pin surya-ocr version in requirements.txt once confirmed working.
